name: hazel_weir_velocity_procedural_graph
description: Optimized Procedural Graph featuring progressive plot expansion synchronized with workforce scaling, Strawberry acreage sovereignty, in-situ watering farm execution, crop phase-gated Town Shop arbitrage, and dynamic capital-velocity liquidation.

nodes.name: State & Balance Audit
nodes.description: Computes net available cash, shed fill percentage, wage liability, active shop contract demand, dynamic livestock feed reserve, and oracle price drop signals across market commodities.

nodes.name: Midnight Wage Reserve Defense
nodes.description: Protects payroll for all active hired hands. Enforces dynamic cash reserve locks and triggers pre-midnight surplus liquidation to prevent the 0-hand bankruptcy cascade.

nodes.name: Town Shop Demand Arbitrage
nodes.description: Fulfills active town shop contracts for 2.0x-3.5x premiums on auxiliary buffer plots. Enforces strict crop maturation phase-gates for seed procurement (Pumpkins D16, Tomatoes D21, Carrots D25) to eliminate stranded capital.

nodes.name: Capital Velocity & Liquidation
nodes.description: Abolishes shed hoarding by executing continuous batch liquidations of uncontracted surplus inventory at favorable market prices, unlocking fluid cash for reinvestment and preventing idle physical stock from bottlenecking farm economy compounding.

nodes.name: Oracle Opponent Front-Run
nodes.description: Reads 96-step TTM forecast to dump sensitive commodities (Wool, Milk, Strawberry) immediately before opponent market gluts collapse prices.

nodes.name: Capital Reinvestment & Yield Scaling
nodes.description: Reinvests surplus cash into progressive land expansion (up to 16 plots by Day 13), workforce scaling (up to 10 hands), and hyper-fertilized Strawberry perennials dedicated on 12-14 sovereign plots.

nodes.name: Routine Farm & Workforce Execution
nodes.description: Executes field routines with cluster harvesting and immediate in-situ watering to eliminate growth-pausing dry intervals, followed by shed drop-off, fertilizer application, feeding, and planting.

attributes.guidance: Cancel non-essential purchases; schedule worker harvest drop-offs before hour 21; enforce emergency liquidation of non-feed, non-contract inventory at hour >= 20 to guarantee payroll.
attributes.pitfalls: Never sell Wheat below dynamic livestock feed reserve (n_animals > 0 ? max(4, n_animals * 3) : 0); never liquidate crops committed to active town shop delivery.

attributes.condition: has_unlocked_shops and (shop_deliverable_inventory > 0 or (net_available_cash >= 180.0 and active_shop_demand > 0 and day <= 25)) and day <= 30
attributes.guidance: Allocate market slots to deliver matching inventory to town shops for 2.0x-3.5x premium through step 710. Procure exact seed quantities for active shop demands strictly within crop maturation phase-gates: Pumpkin seeds only on day <= 16, Tomato seeds only on day <= 21, and Carrot seeds only on day <= 25. Cease all seed procurement after Day 25. Confine shop crops strictly to 2-4 auxiliary plots.
attributes.pitfalls: Never procure Pumpkin seeds after Day 16, Tomato seeds after Day 21, or Carrot seeds after Day 25. Never uproot or till mature Strawberry perennial bushes for town contracts. Do not buy shop seeds if net cash falls below 1.35x midnight payroll.

attributes.guidance: Execute rapid batch sales of unreserved, non-shop surplus holdings: Days 1-8 maintain price floor >= 0.82 * base_price (or shed_used >= 25) to unlock early hand hiring and plot expansion cash; Days 9-28 enforce floor >= 0.86 * base_price (relaxing to >= 0.80 * base_price only if shed_used >= 45) to prevent shed bottlenecks without fire-sale margin bleed; Days 29-30 execute terminal warehouse liquidation sweep (>= 0.70 * base_price on Day 29; sell all remaining uncontracted inventory unrestricted by step 714) ensuring 0 items stranded in shed.
attributes.pitfalls: Never sell Wheat below dynamic livestock feed reserve (n_animals > 0 ? max(4, n_animals * 3) : 0). Never dump crops at severe discounts (< 0.80 * base_price) during mid-game unless shed capacity is critically compromised (> 70 items). Never liquidate exact item quotas reserved for active town shop contracts.

attributes.condition: oracle_glut_risk >= 0.25 and current_price >= 0.75 * base_price and uncontracted_surplus_inventory > 0
attributes.guidance: Preempt lowest-margin open orders; execute rapid batch liquidations of vulnerable commodities (Wool, Milk, Strawberry) while current market price remains favorable (> 0.75 * base_price) before opponent dumping collapses market prices.
attributes.pitfalls: Do not dump into already collapsed sub-0.50 base price markets unless shed overflow is imminent; do not front-run commodities committed to active town shop contracts.

attributes.condition: net_available_cash >= midnight_payroll_due * 1.35 + 80.0 and (hired_hands < 10 or total_plots < 16 or uncultivated_plots > 0 or has_fertilizer_deficit) and day <= 26
attributes.guidance: Prioritize workforce scaling to 10 hired hands. Synchronize progressive contiguous plot expansion: scale to 6-8 plots at hands >= 3 (Days 3-5), 10-12 plots at hands >= 5 (Days 6-8), and cap strictly at 16 plots when hands >= 8 (Days 9-13). Enforce strict land expansion cutoff at Day 13 so all acreage delivers at least 5-6 recurring harvest cycles. Dedicate 12-14 plots permanently to hyper-fertilized Strawberry perennials, reserving 2-4 auxiliary plots for shop contracts. Maintain continuous fertilizer procurement for all Strawberry acreage.
attributes.pitfalls: Never expand land beyond 16 plots or after Day 13. Never till mature Strawberry bushes. Do not purchase single-harvest seeds (Pumpkin, Tomato) unless specifically demanded by an active town shop contract within valid phase-gate days. Never compromise midnight wage reserve for expansion.

attributes.guidance: Dispatch hands using cluster harvesting with immediate in-situ watering. Priority sequence: 1) Cluster Harvest adjacent ready crops up to inventory capacity, 2) Immediate In-Situ Watering of dry/harvested plots before moving to prevent growth stalls, 3) Shed Drop-off of carried harvest and retrieval of fertilizer if unfertilized Strawberry plots exist, 4) Apply carried Fertilizer to unfertilized Strawberry plots, 5) Feed livestock (only if n_animals > 0), 6) Plant seeds (Strawberry on dedicated perennial plots, shop seeds on auxiliary plots), 7) Weed/Till uncultivated plots. Ensure all carried inventory is deposited at the shed by step 716.
attributes.pitfalls: Never deprioritize in-situ watering below shed transit, as dry plots freeze regrowth timers. Never fetch fertilizer with a full harvest bag (drop off harvest first to prevent bag deadlocks). Never waste worker steps or feed Wheat when livestock count is 0. Ensure hands never idle while unharvested crops or dry plots remain.
